_comment: Where the kicksaw-uat skill installs the Kicksaw UAT App from. Standard path: deploy the source of a tagged GitHub release. Update 'latest' when a new release is tagged. The package section is optional and unused until a package version exists.

latest.notes: 0.5.3 plus: the Slack alert's details box says Severity instead of Priority (same field). No setup change; a Workflow Builder webhook still needs the variables bar, name, details and link (see setup step 5).

source.visibility: public: anyone can download a release; no GitHub login needed
source.slackAlertsOnce: slack-alerts (deploy once at setup when the project wants Slack alerts; never on upgrade)

package._comment: Optional, for a one-click install link later. TBD until a package version is built.
